name: agent-markdown-render
description: Model response text reaches the screen markdown-rendered, not as literal syntax. Until this scenario existed no e2e fixture emitted a single '**', '#' or code fence, so the stream renderer wired into the agent loop was covered only by unit tests on the renderer itself. Asserted as an exact stdout block: '**' and the backticks around 'isRecord' are gone, the list keeps its bullet and indent, and the fenced block becomes a language label plus a padded, indented body. The fixture splits the text mid-construct across chunks, which pins that the renderer buffers by line rather than rendering each chunk as it arrives. It also pins that an ATX heading renders BOLD with its '#' markers stripped - see docs/map/cli/render/markdown-renderer.md. Boldness needs its own needle: the block assertion strips SGR before matching, so it can only see that the words 'The plan' arrive on row 1 and that '## The plan' never does. The raw '\u001b[1m' needle in stdoutContains is what pins the weight

stdoutBlock: Rewrite guards.ts and keep isRecord exported.
